rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for how effectively resources, energy, or time are used.

example.english: This machine's efficiency is really high: it uses little electricity but works fast.
example.traditional: 呢部機嘅效率真係高，用電少但做嘢快。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gei1 ge3 haau6 leot6 zan1 hai6 gou1 jung6 din6 siu2 daan6 zou6 je5 faai3
